verbatim_quote.original: برای بار آخر، این خیلی مهمه: حتماً حتماً حتماً حتماً، BrainMCP Brain باید به کل فایل تسک یا محتوای اون همیشه دسترسی داشته باشه.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: For the last time, this is very important: absolutely, the Brain MCP Brain must always have access to the whole task file or its content.

extracted_decision.summary: Brain must always receive the full task-file working content on every turn (implemented as auto-attach minus the diff block, Task 200).
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager (stated with quadruple emphasis) considers complete Brain context non-negotiable for correct behavior.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Larger prompts per turn in exchange for guaranteed complete context.
